senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Injurious, destructive.
E.
नश to destroy, णुकन् Uṇādi affix, and नुम् inserted.

mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ)
An injurer, injurious, destructive.
E.
नश to destroy, affix तृच्, and नुम् inserted.

f. (-न्दा)
A husband's sister.
E.
न negative, नन्द to please, ऋत् Uṇādi affix; also the penultimate being made long, ननान्दृ.

ind.
1 A particle of interrogation, (how, what.)
2 Of affirmation, (certainly.)
3 Of assent.
4 A consolatory and kind expression.
5 A vocative particle, (ho, hola,) or one implying kindness, conciliation, (pray, good friend, &c.)
6 An inceptive particle, implying doubt or dissent, (may be, but, on the other hand.)
7 A responsive particle.
8 A particle of reproach.
E.
न negative, नुद to send or command, affix डु.

ind.
An inceptive particle, implying doubt, dissent, or contradiction.
E.
ननु as above, and च particle.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be saluted, to be revered or honoured.
E.
नम to salute, तव्य aff.

mf. (-न्दः-न्दी)
Happiness, pleasure, felicity.
m. (-न्दः)
1 One of KUVERA'S nine inestimable gems or treasure.
2 The cowherd NANDA, the foster father of KṚṢṆA.
3 A name of VIṢṆU.
4 A prince, the son of MAHĀNANDI.
5 A flute, one eleven inches long.
f. (-न्दा)
1 An earthen water jar.
2 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of the fortnight.
3 Prosperity, increase.
4 A husband's sister.
f. (-न्दी)
INDRA'S garden.
f. (-न्दा or -न्दी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
नदि to be prosperous or happy, affix अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Rejoicing, making happy or delighted.
2 Cherishing or rearing a family.
m. (-कः)
1 Happiness, pleasure.
2 The sword of KṚṢṆA.
3 The foster father of KṚṢṆA.
4 A frog.
E.
नदि to make happy, affix वुन्.

f. (-किः)
Long pepper.
E.
नदि to delight, affix कि.

m. (-की)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
नन्दक, and इनि aff.

f. (-ता)
A plant: see रास्ना.

m. (-थुः)
Happiness, felicity.
E.
नदि to be happy, affix अथुच्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Delighting, rejoicing, making pleased or happy.
m. (-नः)
1 A son.
2 A frog.
3 VIṢṆU.
n. (-नं)
INDRA'S pleasure ground, elysium.
2 A species of the Dhṛti metre.
f. (-ना)
A daughter.
E.
नदि to be or make happy, affix ल्यु.

m. (-नः)
A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
नन्द, and नन्दन a son; the son of NANDA.

f. (-नी)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and नन्दिनी a daughter.

m. (-न्तः)
1 A son.
2 A friend.
3 A prince.
E.
नदि to make happy, झच् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-ला)
A chaplet or garland made by KṚṢṆA.
E.
नन्दन delighting, माला a garland.

mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत)
Making happy, delighting.
E.
नदि to be happy, causal v., शतृ aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ती-न्तं)
Making happy, rejoicing, delighting.
E.
नदि in the causal form, with झच् aff.

m. (-लः)
A name of VARUṆA.
E.
नन्द KUVERA'S treasure, and पाल who guards.

f. (-त्री)
DURGĀ.
E.
नन्द the cowherd NANDA, and पुत्री a daughter; the goddess becoming incarnate, as the infant daughter of NANDA.

m. (-जः)
KṚṢṆA.
f. (-जा)
DURGĀ.
E.
नन्द as above, and आत्मज offspring: see नन्दनन्दन; also नन्दपुत्र, नन्दसुत, &c.

mn. (-न्दिः-न्दि)
1 Gambling, gaming.
2 Happiness.
m. (-न्दिः)
1 One of ŚIVA'S principal attendants.
2 The speaker of the prologue or prelude to a drama.
3 One who pronounces a benediction.
E.
नदि to make happy, and इन् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-न्दी)
1 Eulogium of a king, or praise of a deity, recited in benedictory verses at the commencement of a religious ceremony, or the opening of a drama; it most usually signifies the kind of blessing pronounced as a prologue to a Nāṭaka or play.
2 Prosperity, thriving, increase.
E.
नदि to be happy, in the causal form, affix इन्, and ङीष्; delighting the gods, &c. or procuring happiness for mankind.

m. (-कः)
Tūn, a tree, the wood of which resembles mahogany, and is used for furniture, &c. (Cedrela tunna.)
f. (-का)
1 INDRA'S garden or pleasure ground.
2 An earthen water pot.
3 The first, sixth, or eleventh day of a fortnight.
E.
नन्द, with कन् or ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A post in a door-way, set up for good luck.
E.
नान्दी prosperity, कृ to make, affix ड.

m. (-रः)
1 One of ŚIVA'S chief attendants.
2 An inferior Purāṇa.
E.
नन्दिक INDRA'S garden, and ईश्वर master.

m. (-षः)
1 The car of ARJUNA.
2 The acclaim or proclamation of a panegyrist or herald.
E.
नन्दि happy, and घोष sound.

mfn. (-न्दी-न्दिनी-न्दि)
Happy, rejoiced, delighted.
m. (-न्दी)
1 The name of one of ŚIVA'S chamberlains, and chief attendants.
2 The Indian fig tree.
3 Pārspīpal, (Hibiscus populneoides.)
4 The speaker of the prelude or prologue to a drama.
f. (-न्दिनी)
1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ.
2 GAṄGĀ, the river goddess.
3 A husband's sister.
4 A fabulous cow, related to the cow of plenty, and the property of the sage VAŚIṢṬHA.
5 The Alakanandā river.
6 The mother of the writer VYĀḌI.
E.
नन्द happiness, इनि aff.

m. (-यः)
A name of VYĀḌI, author of a vocabulary.
E.
नन्दिनी as above, and तनय a son; also similar compounds, as नन्दिनीसुत, नन्दिनीपुत्त्र, &c.

m. (-नः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 The last day of either half of the month, the full or new moon.
3 A son.
4 A friend.
E.
नन्दि happiness, &c. and वर्द्धन increasing.

m. (-क्षः)
The Tūn tree.
E.
नन्दि pleasure, and वृक्ष a tree: also ङीष् being added to नन्दि, नन्दीवृक्ष; or with कन् added, नन्दिवृक्षक.

m. (-टः)
A bald-headed man.
E.
नन्दि ŚIVA'S bald-headed attendant, and अट who resembles, deriv. irr.

f. (-खी)
Sleep, drowsiness.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of NANDĪ, ŚIVA'S attendant.
2 A name of ŚIVA.
3 A species of musical rhythm.
E.
नन्दी INDRA'S garden, or नन्दि a proper name, ईश master.

m. (-रः)
A name of ŚIVA, &c.: see the last.
E.
नन्दि ŚIVA'S chamberlain, and ईश्वर master.

n. (-रः)
A lake or pond in INDRA'S garden.
E.
नन्दी the garden, सरस् a piece of water.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 A sort of temple.
2 A tree, (Tabernæmontana coronaria): see तगर.
3 A peculiar diagram.
E.
नन्दी happiness, आवर्त्त abode.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Bending or bowing very low.
E.
नम to bow, intens. form, शानच् aff.

ind.
1 Without, except.
2 Many, various.
3 Double or twofold.
E.
नञ् negative, and नाञ् aff.

m. (-निः)
A musical instrument of more than one tone.
E.
नाना various, and ध्वनि sound.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Of different flavours.
E.
नाना, and रस flavour.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Variegated, of many colours.
E.
नाना, and राग colour.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
Multiform, various.
E.
नाना various, and रूप form.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Variegated, many-coloured.
E.
नाना, and वर्ण colour.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 In various ways.
2 Of various sorts or kinds.
E.
नाना, and विध kind.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Improper, unusual, not right or customary.
E.
न not, अनु according to, ष्ठेय from स्था to be, to be fixed or determined.

m. (-रः)
The speaker of the prologue to a drama: see नान्दीकर.

m. (-रः)
The speaker of the prologue or prelude of a drama.
E.
नान्दी as above, कर who makes; also with the vowel made short, नान्दिकर.

m. (-टः)
The lid or cover of a well.

m. (-खः)
1 The lid or cover of a well.
2 The class of male progenitors to whom the Nāndī-mukha Śrāddha is addressed.
f. (-खी)
A female ancestor sharing in the same.
n. (-खं)
1 A species of the Śarkarī metre.
2 A Śrāddha or funeral obsequies performed on joyous occasions, as initiation, marriage, &c. in which nine balls of meat are offered to the deceased father, paternal grandfather, and great grandfather; to the maternal grandfather, great grandfather, and great great grandfather; and to the mother, paternal grandmother, and paternal great grandmother.
E.
नान्दी good fortune, मुख principal.

m. (-दी)
1 The speaker of the prologue or introduction to a drama.
2 A drummer, one who beats a drum at festivals, &c.
E.
नान्दी as above, and वादिन् who speaks.
